import os
path='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u041/system/state/workspace/programs/task-02ec5224.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    """Fill the interiors of hollow rectangular frames; even-area interiors use 2, odd use 7."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            # Rectangular frame boundary must be entirely this color.
            if all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1)):
                fill = 2 if ((r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)) % 2 == 0 else 7
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                        if grid[y][x] == background:
                            out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
open(path,'w').write(code)
print(path)
